analyst_view.overall: Sparta Prague (22nd, 4 pts) host AZ (14th, 6 pts) at Letná, a rematch of last March's Conference League tie that AZ won 2-1 and 4-0. Sparta are in a poor spell and coach Brian Priske was reported under pressure after a home defeat to Liberec; they are without defender Tobias Guddal, banned after his red card against Bournemouth (confirmed again by Starting11's availability list), and one earlier report also had Jan Hoever out. The numbers list Sparta's injured Karabec, Rynes and others but no longer count Guddal's ban, so a thinner back line is something they do not fully see. AZ won 5-1 at Sparta Rotterdam at the weekend despite missing Kees Smit, Stije Resink, Lewis Schouten, Weslley Patati and Jizz Hornkamp, most of which the numbers and AZ's recent form already show. No referee is named yet and fresh news this far out was thin (I could find only one new team-news page);  I lean slightly higher on goals and shots on target.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals, 1.3 for Sparta and 1.7 for AZ, and already count Karabec, Schouten and Hornkamp. They no longer count Guddal's ban, and Hoever may be out too (one report), on a side that has conceded heavily lately while AZ just scored five, so I go slightly higher, about 3.1.

corners.text: The numbers expect 9.6 corners, 5.8 for AZ. AZ like to work the ball wide and Sparta have conceded more corners lately (already counted, +2%); a weaker Sparta defence changes chance quality more than corner count, so I stay at 9.6.

cards.text: The numbers expect 4.3 cards and already raise Sparta's by about 4% for a card-heavy run. A frustrated home side and an unhappy crowd can add fouls, but that mood is mostly what recent form shows, and no referee is named yet, so I stay at 4.3.

shots.text: The numbers expect 26.6 shots and already push AZ's up about 12% for their busy recent attack. AZ will have most of the ball; without Smit their midfield is less creative, which roughly cancels Sparta's weaker defence on volume, so I stay at 26.6.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers expect 8.8 shots on target. With Guddal banned and Sparta shaky at the back, AZ should get a few cleaner looks than the numbers assume, so I go slightly higher, about 9.1.
